title: Capability registry descriptor
description: One entry in the Punar capability registry (spec section 41). Describes a typed capability: identity, support, current/desired state, mutability, reboot implications, risk, managing authority, and verification mechanism (the section 41 example), plus the section 41 prose requirements: state schema, allowed desired states, privilege required, approval requirements, and audit category. This is a JSON runtime record emitted by punard, so field names are snake_case. current_state and desired_state are capability-specific values; see $defs/state_value for the convention and state_schema for the per-capability authority.

capability.title: Capability id
capability.description: Dotted snake_case capability identifier, e.g. 'security.firewall', 'system.install_package' (spec sections 28, 41).

supported.title: Supported
supported.description: Whether this capability is supported on this device/build (spec section 41 example). Unsupported capabilities are report-only entries and map to the 'unsupported' compliance state (spec section 52).

current_state.title: Current state
current_state.description: Observed, normalized actual state of the capability (spec section 41 example; spec section 42 'Normalize Actual State'). Capability-specific value — see $defs/state_value; the authoritative value space is this descriptor's state_schema when present.

desired_state.title: Desired state
desired_state.description: Desired state of the capability as resolved from desired-state sources and policy (spec section 41 example; spec sections 38, 39, 42 'Load Desired State'). Capability-specific value — see $defs/state_value; must be one of allowed_desired_states when that list is present.

mutable.title: Mutable
mutable.description: Whether the capability's state can be changed on this device (spec section 41 example). An immutable capability is observe/report-only.

requires_reboot.title: Requires reboot
requires_reboot.description: Reboot implications: whether applying a desired-state change requires a reboot to take effect (spec section 41 example and prose 'reboot implications').

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: Risk level of mutating this capability: low | medium | high (spec sections 28, 41).

managed_by.title: Managed by
managed_by.description: Identifier of the management authority that owns reconciliation for this capability (spec section 41 example value 'smplify').

verification.title: Verification mechanism
verification.description: Mechanism used to verify the actual state after apply (spec section 41 example value 'nftables'; spec section 42 'Verify' step).

state_schema.title: State schema
state_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing the value space of current_state / desired_state — the spec section 41 prose requirement that capabilities 'must describe schema'. May be any valid schema, including a boolean schema, so this property is deliberately open (no additionalProperties restriction). Optional: when absent, the state space is documented only by the $defs/state_value convention.

allowed_desired_states.title: Allowed desired states
allowed_desired_states.description: Enumeration of the desired-state values this capability accepts (spec section 41 prose 'allowed desired states'). Each item is a capability-specific state value. Optional: may be absent when the state space is continuous or is fully described by state_schema; may be empty for immutable capabilities.

items.title: Allowed state value
items.description: One acceptable desired-state value for this capability (spec section 41).

privilege_required.title: Privilege required
privilege_required.description: Privilege level required to mutate this capability (spec section 41 prose 'privilege required'). Lowercase snake_case identifier; not an enum because the spec does not enumerate privilege levels.

approval_requirement.title: Approval requirement
approval_requirement.description: Approval requirement for mutating this capability (spec section 41 prose 'approval requirements'), expressed with the shared policy decision enum (spec section 20): 'allow' means no approval needed, 'deny' means mutation is refused, 'approval_required' means mutation is gated on an approval (spec section 28). The manifest-local credential value 'request' is not valid here.

audit_category.title: Audit category
audit_category.description: Category attached to audit events emitted when this capability is observed, mutated, or remediated (spec section 41 prose 'audit category'; audit events in spec section 53). Lowercase snake_case, optionally dotted.

state_value.title: Capability state value
state_value.description: A capability-specific state value (spec section 41). Deliberately open — this schema accepts any JSON value — because the value space differs per capability and is authoritatively described by the descriptor's state_schema. Convention: simple toggle capabilities use lowercase snake_case strings (e.g. 'enabled', 'disabled'); richer capabilities may use numbers, objects, or arrays. Consumers must not assume string.
